subject: CAIQ consolidation for post-merger carve-out: control mapping & evidence ask
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orangecorp.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: mna-security@orangecorp.com, tom.becker@lawfirm.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ consolidation ask for post-merger carve-out

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to take a look — we closed on the MXA acquisition last week and our security team needs a consolidated CAIQ mapping for the portion of MXA that will remain in the combined SaaS offering (carve-out). We want to confirm Redwood's control coverage and gather the minimum evidentiary artifacts legal needs for the carve-out timeline.

Top asks:
- Consolidated CAIQ crosswalk covering both product lines, with our requested scope boundary highlighted.
- For any controls that differ between MXA and Redwood, a short rationale and the preferred artifact we can provide (logs, runbooks, attestations).
- A short list of control owners we can route requests to (name + role).
- Any redaction guidance for runtime logs (we can accept redacted samples).

Timebox: we need the crosswalk and owner roster by next Wednesday 2026-09-30 to satisfy our legal diligence. If some artifacts will take longer, flag them and provide interim alternatives.

I attached a consolidated ask PDF and an initial carve-out scope (CSV) — please confirm receipt and let me know who at Redwood will own each area.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of M&A Security, OrangeCorp

Attachments: orange-acq-caiq-request-20260925.pdf, initial-scope-carveout.csv

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orangecorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ consolidation ask for post-merger carve-out

Sarah — thanks, received both attachments and read the scope file. We'll own this from the Redwood side. Internal plan at a glance:
- Kimberly will lead the CAIQ crosswalk and artifact index.
- Marissa will coordinate evidence collection and client-facing notes.
- Rishi will surface any contractual/SLA boundary implications for Dedicated/Private deployment items.

We can provide the initial consolidated crosswalk and owner roster by 2026-09-30 as requested. A couple quick clarifying Qs that would speed this up:
1) Do you want the CAIQ answers in CSA JSON format or Excel (we can produce both, Excel is faster)?
2) For runtime logs, is a 30-day redacted sample acceptable, or do you need a full-config retention proof?
3) Are there specific MXA features we should prioritize mapping (e.g., multi-tenant routing, third-party connectors)?

I'll upload the mapping template and an outline of our approach to a shared Drive folder (link to follow). Attaching the mapping template I typically use — fill will be in the shared Drive, not in-line in email.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: caiq-mapping-template-v2.xlsx

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, sarah.lin@orangecorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ consolidation ask for post-merger carve-out

Thanks Lauren / Sarah — quick note on deliverables and approach so expectations are aligned:

Deliverables (by 2026-09-30):
- CAIQ consolidated crosswalk (Excel): three columns per control — Redwood answer, MXA answer, consolidation note + chosen artifact type.
- Owner roster: control -> engineering/ops/infosec owner (name + email).
- Evidence index: for each control, primary artifact name and expected delivery ETA.
- Redaction guide + sample: short doc describing how we redact PII/sensitive config from logs (we'll provide a 30-day redacted sample).

Approach:
- We'll start with automated diff of the two CAIQ exports (if MXA can provide their CAIQ export, great — otherwise we will map by feature list).
- Anything that is a procedural difference (e.g., incident response runbook) we'll annotate with a remediation/merge action and suggest a single canonical artifact to use going forward.
- Where MXA uses a different vendor, we'll note compensating controls and whether an SOC2/third-party attestation exists.

Quick ask for your team, Sarah: can MXA share either a CAIQ export or a link to their control documentation? Also confirm that redacted 30-day logs are acceptable (we will follow the attached sample-log-redaction-guidance).

I uploaded the mapping template and starter sheet to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcqShare (access granted to your security mailbox).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-log-redaction-guidance.txt

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@orangecorp.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: mna-security@orangecorp.com, tom.becker@lawfirm.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ consolidation ask for post-merger carve-out

Kim / Lauren — thanks for the clear plan. MXA can export a CSV extract of their CAIQ answers by EOD today and we'll drop it in the Drive folder. Redacted 30-day logs are acceptable as long as the following are present: timestamps, service identifiers, and request/response codes (we can redact payloads and user identifiers).

One caveat from legal: we need a separate column in the crosswalk that states whether the artifact contains client data, since that will determine retention/escrow language. If you can add that to the template, it will help speed review.

Tom (cc'd) — FYI on timeline.

Sarah

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 08:50 AM PDT Tom Becker <tom.becker@lawfirm.com> wrote:
> Received and noted. If any control has residency or export implications, flag it explicitly so legal can advise on carve-out clauses.
>
> - Tom

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: sarah.lin@orangecorp.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ consolidation ask for post-merger carve-out

Team — final internal checklist and owners: please action before EOD 2026-09-30. We are committed to OrangeCorp's deadline.

Action items:
- Kimberly: Produce consolidated CAIQ crosswalk + add "contains_client_data" column to the template. Deliverable: shared Excel in Drive (file name: redwood-orangecorp-caiq-consolidated-20260930.xlsx).
- Marissa: Begin evidence pull for controls with "high" artifact effort (audit logs, key rotation proofs). Coordinate with eng owners and post ETA in the Drive sheet.
- Rishi: Review any Dedicated/Private deployment controls and call out contractual implications; ping legal if residency/export risk appears.

If any control owners cannot meet the timeline, surface a blocker and an interim alternative (e.g., attestations or SOC/third-party reports). I'll send a brief summary to Sarah when the package is uploaded.

Thanks all — this will help finalize the carve-out SOW.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head, Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
